# Decoder request

Use this PR when your app needs the KaspaCom indexer/explorer to decode and
display your on-chain data.

## Request file

- [ ] I added one request file under `requests/`.
- [ ] I copied `TEMPLATE.yml` instead of editing the template itself.
- [ ] The request file is named with a stable slug, for example `my-app-market.yml`.
- [ ] I included public txids, addresses, outpoints, artifacts, or fixtures that maintainers can reproduce.
- [ ] I filled the expected decoded actions and expected explorer/API output.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_request.py requests/<my-request>.yml`.
- [ ] I did not include private keys, seed phrases, API keys, unpublished user data, or secrets.
- [ ] I understand maintainers may accept the request first, then assign decoder/API/explorer implementation work.
